name: 紅胸秋沙鴨

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC；香港稀少冬候／過境

illustrationTaxon: Mergus serrator adult male in breeding plumage, for main art and all four male diagnostic feature crops

similarSpecies.distinction: 白秋沙鴨雄鳥體型較細小，白色頭身具明顯黑眼罩及黑紋；紅胸秋沙鴨雄鳥較大，具長紅喙、深色蓬冠、白領及帶白斑的栗色胸。
鵲鴨雄鳥頭圓且有單一橢圓白頰斑、淡黃色眼、粗短身形及大白翼窗；紅胸秋沙鴨雄鳥頭具蓬冠、喙長而窄呈紅色、胸側有白斑。

featureNotes: 長而狹的紅色鋸狀喙，適合捕魚
紅色虹膜及深綠黑色頭部的短蓬冠
栗色胸部上脅有醒目的大型白斑
灰色脅部與黑白分段的折翼紋理

rangeMap.note: Full-world partial country overview representing selected parts of the Holarctic breeding range and coastal/selected wintering areas described by HKBWS. Highlights are a subset only; green does not mean nationwide occupancy and this is not a complete distribution or precise seasonal occurrence polygon. Hong Kong is a rare wintering and passage visitor area, not a resident-range claim.

sources.use: Full HKBWS species account read: 52–58 cm; male breeding plumage has dark green head, white collar, black-mottled brown chest with large white spots on upper flanks; long narrow red bill, red eyes and short sometimes spiky crest. Hong Kong rare winter visitor/passage migrant, much declined locally since late 1980s/early 1990s; global IUCN LC, stable. Breeds Holarctic and winters in selected North American and Eurasian regions.
Full HKBWS Smew account read: male breeding plumage is white with black mask and markings; used as a clearly labelled male comparison.

Full HKBWS Common Goldeneye account read: male has green-glossed domed dark head, oval white bill-base spot, pale eye, white neck/chest/flanks and dark upperparts; Hong Kong Category I accidental. Used as a clearly labelled male comparison, not as an abundance assertion.
Reviewed exact adult male Smew image reused as the correctly labelled Smew comparison; no recolouring or taxonomic relabelling.
Reviewed exact adult male Common Goldeneye image reused as the correctly labelled Goldeneye comparison; no recolouring or taxonomic relabelling.

notes: All four feature crops depict the adult male, named explicitly. Main and features artwork must show a distinctive long red bill, green-black crested head, white collar and chestnut breast with white spots.
The Smew and Common Goldeneye comparisons are exact, separately species-specific male artworks reused from their reviewed cards, not repainted or relabelled Red-breasted Merganser art.
AI illustrations receive basic visual review only and are not independent ornithologist validation. Comparison circles are not to scale.
